title: Most Of Earth's Ocean Floor Still Has No Modern Map
hook: The largest unmapped landscape is beneath ships, not beyond Earth.
closing: Modern seafloor maps still leave a planet-sized blind spot on Earth.
question: Would you map ocean or Mars?

segments.say: Modern maps cover 28.7% of the ocean floor in 2026. Most seafloor still lacks detailed mapping.
Mars is 99.5% mapped. Its surface coverage makes the ocean floor gap look extraordinary.
Unmapped ocean floor spans 257 million square kilometers. The missing map covers more area than all of Mars.
